title: Late flexible-rate cancellation with a verified duplicate booking
facts_text: I have a Flexible Rate reservation for 20 October. I am requesting cancellation on 19 October at 17:00, after the 15:00 cancellation deadline. The hotel system confirms that I accidentally made two identical reservations for the same guest, property and stay dates.
request: Can you cancel one of the duplicate reservations and provide a full refund?

strict.reason: The cancellation request was made after the 15:00 deadline, and the strict policy permits no additional exception.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The cancellation request was made after the normal deadline, but the hotel has verified an accidental duplicate booking for the same guest, property and stay dates, satisfying the experimental exception.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The ambiguous policy permits exceptional circumstances to be considered without defining the eligibility criteria, so the decision is discretionary.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Verify that the duplicate-booking facts satisfy every condition of the researcher-created exception. The duplicate-booking exception is experimental and is not presented as an official easyHotel policy.
